title: Three-line welcome
pitch: Add a small greeting, workspace hint, and useful tip to your shell profile.
makeItYours: Use the PowerShell body in $PROFILE after the param block, and replace the fixed greeting with your preferred text.
Replace the sample workspace and branch with cached local values; keep startup free of network calls.
Swap the help tip for a command you use often, keeping the greeting within three lines.
useCase: Use it when your shell profile needs a useful greeting in three lines.
